app.title: GelFigure · Gel figure preparation & AI review
tour.step1.title: Drop a gel or try the example
tour.step1.body: Drop any TIFF/PNG/JPG gel image into the window to start, or try the built-in example gel first.
tour.step2.title: AI automatic processing
tour.step2.body: With a vision API configured, dropping a gel runs perspective correction, lane detection and marker labelling automatically; local offline detection is always available.
tour.step3.title: Click lane names directly
tour.step3.body: Click any lane name on the figure to type, press Enter for the next lane, or paste a whole row at once.
tour.step4.title: Export readiness & formats
tour.step4.body: Inspect resolution, saturation and font-size checks anytime, then export PNG, TIFF, SVG, editable PPTX or a review ZIP.
tour.step5.title: Find it useful? Star on GitHub
tour.step5.body: GelFigure is free and open-source. Star the repository or open an issue to share feedback.
